objective: Assess the real current implementation against the complete mechanical-error prevention system and produce a planner-ready package that grounds every missing mechanism and end-to-end acceptance boundary without narrowing the goal.
research_questions: Does every operational sequence have one executable owner for initialization through terminal emission?
Are mechanical operations typed and schema-validated rather than reconstructed through shell, JSON, or text manipulation?
Is sequence applicability intercepted and enforced before every mechanical action rather than depending on voluntary registry consultation?
Does a same-path-verified correction prohibit the failed fingerprint and become the mandatory successor?
Is intent through promoted registered reuse one automatically joined causal learning lifecycle?
Does admission reserve the entire atomic unit before long work begins?
Can every completed transition resume idempotently from durable state?
Do system-wide metrics prove registered reuse, prevented failures, recurrence reduction, and mechanical-overhead targets?
in_scope: memory-knowledge operational sequence registry, selector, guard, checked execution, observer, blocker/correction ledger, discovery, promotion, registered verification, budget, resume, and metrics contracts
research-playbook execution only as one representative sequence and integration surface, not as the whole system
mcp-agents-workflow and Codex action boundaries only where required to ground automatic pre-action interception
all eight user-provided enforcement properties and all six user-provided measurable completion conditions
exclusions: implementation planning or code changes during research
commit, push, deployment, secret access, external messaging, or phase-ledger contract changes
conversation transcripts, hidden reasoning, personal data, credentials, or raw terminal output as durable learning evidence
dashboard or user-interface design beyond the metric contracts required for acceptance
sequence catalog cleanup unrelated to the prevention-system acceptance requirements
supplied_input: The complete prevention system has one executable sequence owner, typed operations, automatic pre-action interception, mandatory verified correction replacement, automatic causal discovery-to-promotion learning, full-unit budget admission, durable idempotent resume, and system-wide enforcement metrics. Completion requires zero raw JSON/text patching in governed runs, zero repeated mechanical fingerprints, no under-budget long-stage start, mandatory reuse of verified corrections, at least 95 percent registered use for recurring actions, and mechanical overhead below 5 to 10 percent.
terminal_rules: PASS requires all three lenses to pass the same candidate and envelope hashes, a fresh adjudicator with no research-actionable finding, every planner obligation READY, exact package validation, and zero active agent slots.
GAPS means research-stage corrections remain inside this frozen charter.
BLOCKED means required accessible evidence or a named approval route is unavailable.
CAP_REACHED means the shared time, round, attempt, retry, or repeated-fingerprint cap fired.
